items.title: feat(skills)!: give each agent its own Skill Workshop (#135528)
items.summary: feat(skills)!: give each agent its own Skill Workshop (#135528) Give each agent one writable Workshop collection outside its session workspaces. Use one proposal and apply path for background learning, collection review, installation, and audit. Anchor asynchronous reviews to the completed turn, preserve interrupted learning, and skip review calls for provider refusals. Recover interrupted applies before Doctor relocates legacy skills. Reuse the existing recovery transition and retain blocked sources and destinations in one migration plan. Keep unresolved proposals inspectable without changing their files. Commit relocation metadata atomically and preserve skill-only workspace recovery. Remove workspace-derived ownership, duplicate autonomous writes, and the retired symlink-target-write setting. Retain schema and configuration upgrade handling. Use shared skill discovery for deep audit of grouped, hidden and shadowed Workshop skills. Report broken links, inaccessible roots and incomplete inventories, and document selection priority separately from file preservation. BREAKING CHANGE: Workshop skills are agent-owned. The approved state-v16 migration retires workspace/release ownership fields and skills.workshop.allowSymlinkTargetWrites; Doctor preserves and relocates proven legacy skills. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
